errors.network: The server is not answering. Check the connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not cover this object.
errors.unexpected: The server refused the request. Status {{status}}.

refusal.title: The request was refused

blockedBy.rooms_one: {{count, number}} room is attached to this dormitory.
blockedBy.rooms_other: {{count, number}} rooms are attached to this dormitory.

refusal.blockedWayOut: Move or delete the rooms first — or archive the dormitory instead, and the residency history stays readable.
refusal.conflictWhere: Room {{room}}, place {{bed}}, contract {{contract}}. Record the move-out first.
refusal.conflictAnonymous: a resident the answer did not name
refusal.conflictUnknown: The server refused but attached no conflicting record.
refusal.validationTitle: The form is filled in incorrectly
refusal.serverFault: The server failed to process the request. Its own message is withheld here: a fault is not a refusal, and its text is for the log, not for the screen.
refusal.mandatoryTitle: The category cannot be switched off
refusal.mandatoryBody: The server refused the attempt to switch «{{category}}» off.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Place label
fields.override_reason: Reason for admitting on the decision
fields.title: Title

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Accounts are issued by the dormitory administration.
login.invalid: The email or the password is wrong.
login.attemptsLeft_one: {{count}} attempt left before sign-in is blocked.
login.attemptsLeft_other: {{count}} attempts left before sign-in is blocked.
login.lastAttemptUsed: That was the last attempt: sign-in for this email is closed.
login.lockedBody: Five failed attempts close sign-in for this email. You can try again in {{remaining}}.
login.lockedOver: The block has expired, try signing in again.
login.throttledBody: Too many requests have come from this device in a row and the server stopped taking them. You can try again in {{remaining}}.
login.throttledBodySoon: Too many requests have come from this device in a row and the server stopped taking them. Try again shortly.

validation.email: Enter an email in the form name@example.com.
validation.other: The field “{{field}}” is filled in incorrectly.

login.sessionExpired: The session ended. Sign in again.
login.note: The token is kept until the tab is closed, so a session does not outlive a shift on the shared computer at the security post.
login.firstPassword: Received a one-time code? Set your own password

register.heading: Register of dormitories
register.leadAdmin: Creating, editing, archiving and deleting belong to the administrator. The server takes the decision: a request from another role is refused.
register.leadScoped: The dormitories your account is attached to. The server narrows the list.
register.empty: No dormitory is visible to you. If that is wrong, ask the administrator.

building.heading: Building card
building.visitingNote: The visiting window is the span in which a guest may stay in the building in the presence of the resident who invited them.

rooms.heading: Rooms and places
rooms.lead: Capacity is the ceiling the warden registers places up to. The free remainder and the vacancies are two different figures, and both are named below.
rooms.empty: This dormitory has no rooms yet.
rooms.remainder_one: {{count, number}} more place may be registered
rooms.remainder_other: {{count, number}} more places may be registered
rooms.numberNote: Unique inside the dormitory. Usually the floor and two digits: 305 is room 5 on the third floor.
rooms.capacityNote: How many places the room may hold. Lowering it below the places already registered is refused by the server.
rooms.statusNote: A room that is not in service takes no new residents, however many of its places are empty.

places.none: The room holds no places yet.
places.label: Place {{label}}
places.remainder_one: {{count, number}} place short of the capacity of {{capacity}}.
places.remainder_other: {{count, number}} places short of the capacity of {{capacity}}.
places.unnamed: Name not read: the resident card is not available
places.roomClosedNote: The room is not in service

residency.noCandidates: The roll of this dormitory lists no residents.
residency.candidateNote: The choice is limited to people already attached to this dormitory.
residency.groundNote: The ground is recorded verbatim: an order number, a decision of the committee.
residency.assignSummary: To be recorded: room {{room}}, place {{bed}}, from {{date}}
residency.releaseGroundNote: Without a ground the server refuses. It is recorded verbatim — for instance, “graduation, art. 105 cl. 2 of the Housing Code”.
residency.releaseDateNote: The place is free at once. The resident's access to building-bound functions ends on the stated date, which may be set forward.
residency.unknownRecord: The residency record has not been read, so the move-out cannot be filed. Open the resident card instead.
residency.issueAccount: The person you need is not on the roll? Issue them an account

plan.heading: Floor plan
plan.notAPlan: This is not a drawing of the premises. The data holds a floor number and a room number and nothing about where the doors are, so the rooms are laid out as a grid per floor rather than as a layout.
plan.namesFromCards: The names come from the resident cards of this dormitory. Every card read is written to the audit log — it is a read of personal data.
plan.namesWithheld: Resident names are not shown: the cards are closed to your role in this dormitory.
plan.cardsRefused_one: The server refused {{count, number}} card — that place is left unnamed.
plan.cardsRefused_other: The server refused {{count, number}} cards — those places are left unnamed.

resident.heading: Resident card
resident.auditNote: The card carries personal data, so reading it is written to the audit log.
resident.noPlace: Holds no place at the moment.
resident.obligationsNote: In this version the register knows one kind of obligation — an accommodation contract that has not been terminated. Obligations arising from the inventory handover come later.

people.heading: People of the building
people.empty: Nobody is listed in this building yet.
people.hint: The roll is open to the administrator and to the warden, manager or duty officer of this building. Other roles are refused by the server.

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.lead: Entries are written by the server and cannot be edited. Reading the log is itself logged.

actions.guest_request.decision_refused: Decision on a guest request refused
actions.checkpoint.admitted_on_decision: Admitted on the responsible officer's decision

staff.heading: Staff of the building
staff.leadAdmin: The administrator appoints the warden. Everything below the warden is the warden’s own to appoint.
staff.leadWarden: The warden appoints the manager, the duty officer and security in building no. {{id}} and nowhere else. The warden is appointed by the administrator.
staff.leadReadOnly: There is nothing here for you to appoint: the server refuses any attempt. Below is what you are shown.
staff.rosterEmpty: Nobody holds a staff role in this building yet.
staff.residentsNote: Residents are not listed here: “resident” is not a post. The full roll of the building sits on the card.
staff.revokeBody: {{name}} loses access to building no. {{id}} in this role the moment you confirm. The role can be granted again, but the interrupted access stays interrupted.
staff.appointLead: The role holds in this building only. The scope comes from the address of this page and not from the form — otherwise the person appointing would choose which building they are checked against.
staff.subject: Whom
staff.subjectNote: The list holds people already attached to this building.
staff.accountFieldNote: This version has no search across all accounts. The number is shown on the roll of the building and on a person’s card.
staff.roleNote: Only the roles your own account may grant are offered.
staff.alreadyHeld: {{name}} already held the role “{{role}}”. Nothing changed.

account.heading: Resident account
account.lead: The warden or the manager creates an account for a person moving into building no. {{id}}.
account.leadReadOnly: There is nothing here for you to issue: the server refuses any attempt. An account for an incoming resident is created by the warden or the manager of this building.
account.credentialTitle: No password will appear on this screen
account.credentialBody: The system generates a password, hashes it and forgets it in the same step. What the resident receives at their own address is a one-time code; you will not see it and cannot read it back later.
account.credentialStep1: You fill in the name, the address and the resident’s details.
account.credentialStep2: A letter with a one-time code goes to that address. The code lives an hour and works once.
account.credentialStep3: The resident opens “First sign-in” and sets a password of their own.
account.emailNote: The address the code is delivered to. The one field that can be neither omitted nor repeated from another account.
account.phoneNote: Optional. The code still travels by mail: this version has no second delivery channel.
account.citizenshipNote: Optional. The field is kept for the record of international students.
account.roleNote: The grant will be the resident role in building no. {{id}}. No staff role can be issued through this form — there is no such field, on the screen or on the wire.
account.issuedCredentialSpent: Already spent, a password is set
account.issuedNoPassword: There is no password here and there will not be one. If the letter did not arrive, check the address: a sent code cannot be read back, and this version does not resend it.
account.waitingEmpty: Every account of this building has a password of its own.
account.waitingRow: The code was sent, no password is set yet.
account.waitingNote: The server clears this mark when the resident spends the code. The code itself is not here — the list only says it has not been used.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.lead: The messages of your personal account, newest first. You mark a message read; the server keeps the moment it was first read and never rewrites it.
notifications.credentialNote: The one-time code of a new account never appears here. It goes by mail to the resident's own address and is not kept in the database, so the category is on the settings screen and the row is not on this one.
notifications.unnamedGuest: a guest the message does not name
notifications.visitOverdue: A guest has not left on time: {{guest}}
notifications.visitDuty: A guest is in the dormitory while the resident who invited them is present — clause 2.2 of the rules of internal order.
notifications.maintenanceMoved: The maintenance request has moved to «{{status}}»
notifications.documentAwaiting: A document is waiting for your signature: {{title}}

account_issued.label: Account and credentials
account_issued.description: The one-time code for a new account, and changes to the way you sign in.
account_issued.ground: The ground is the accommodation contract. Without the one-time code the account cannot be used at all, so switching this message off would be declining the access rather than the mail.

request_decision.label: Decision on a guest request
request_decision.description: Your guest request has been approved or refused.

visit_overdue.label: Guest overdue at the entrance
visit_overdue.description: A guest you invited has not left by the hour the rules of internal order set.
visit_overdue.ground: The ground is clause 2.2 of the rules of internal order: a guest is in the dormitory while the resident who invited them is present. The resident answers for the departure, which is why the message goes to them.

maintenance_status.label: Maintenance request status
maintenance_status.description: A maintenance request you filed has moved to another state.

document_signature.label: Document awaiting signature
document_signature.description: A document is waiting for your signature.
document_signature.ground: The ground is the accommodation contract. The document has a deadline, and the deadline has to be told to you.

announcement.label: Announcements of the dormitory
announcement.description: Ordinary notices: events, general news, planned works you are not required to acknowledge.

mandatory_announcement.label: Announcements requiring acknowledgement
mandatory_announcement.description: Notices you are asked to confirm you have read.
mandatory_announcement.ground: The ground is clause 4.2.7 of the rules of internal order: a resident is obliged to acquaint themselves with the instructions of the administration. The acknowledgement is the record that you were told, so the message cannot be switched off.

notificationSettings.heading: Notification categories
notificationSettings.lead: What the system will write to you about. Some categories can be switched off and some cannot, and what that rests on is stated below.
notificationSettings.optionalNote: These messages only save you from opening the application, and they stand on nothing else — only on your consent to the processing of personal data. That is why they can be switched off, and why they stop when the consent is withdrawn.
notificationSettings.mandatoryNote: These messages rest on the accommodation contract and on the rules of internal order rather than on consent. Switching them off would be declining the service and not the mail; the server refuses the request, and the database behind it.
notificationSettings.groundUnstated: The server called the category mandatory and named no ground in its answer.
notificationSettings.silencedTitle: The optional notifications are not arriving
notificationSettings.silencedBody: Your consent to the processing of personal data is not in force: it has been withdrawn, or it has not been given yet. The optional categories stand on it alone, so they stay silent whatever position their switch is in.

consent.heading: Consent to the processing of personal data
consent.separateNote: A screen of its own and not a tick on a form: art. 9 part 1 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ requires consent to be executed separately from other documents. Neither signing in, nor setting a password, nor any other form of this system records a consent.
consent.draftTitle: This text has not been through legal review
consent.draftBody: It is a working placeholder. It states what the system actually does with the data, but the officer responsible for the processing has not approved it. Before the system carries real data the text is replaced by the approved one under a new revision number, and the consent is asked for again.
consent.ifYes: If you agree: the system may send the optional notifications — the decision on your guest request and the movement of a maintenance request — and the security post may see that the guest was invited by you.
consent.ifNo: If you do not: the optional notifications will not arrive. The mandatory ones still will — an overdue guest, a document awaiting signature, the issue of an account.
consent.notBlocking: Your account is not blocked either way. The housing register and the resident card are kept under the accommodation contract, not under this consent.
consent.remaining_one: {{count, number}} more document is waiting for a decision.
consent.remaining_other: {{count, number}} more documents are waiting for a decision.
consent.recordedNote: The record holds the fact, the date and the revision of the text you read. It cannot be deleted even after a withdrawal: the burden of proving consent is on the operator (art. 9 part 3 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ).
consent.nothingPending: Nothing to decide: you have read every text that concerns you and answered on each.
consent.atPostTitle: This consent is taken at the security post
consent.atPostBody: A guest's consent is executed in person, before the security officer records the entry. It is neither given nor withdrawn through the personal account.
consent.strip: The consent to the processing of personal data is waiting for your decision.

consentHistory.heading: Personal data
consentHistory.lead: What you signed, when, and under which revision. The withdrawal is here too.
consentHistory.pendingTitle_one: {{count, number}} document is waiting for a decision
consentHistory.pendingTitle_other: {{count, number}} documents are waiting for a decision
consentHistory.pendingBody: Either you have not read it, or the text has been replaced since you agreed: a consent is given to one particular revision.
consentHistory.effectLead: Read this before you press. A withdrawal has consequences, and closing your account is not one of them.
consentHistory.effectStops: The optional notifications: the decision on a guest request and the status of a maintenance request.
consentHistory.effectKeeps: The housing register, the resident card and the mandatory notifications. They rest on the accommodation contract and on the rules of internal order, not on consent.
consentHistory.effectRecord: The record of the consent is not deleted: it acquires a date of withdrawal. The burden of proving consent for the period before it is on the operator (art. 9 part 3 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ).
consentHistory.effectAfter: You are among those the text is offered to again: the consent may be given afresh at any time.
consentHistory.empty: No records: consent has never been given.
consentHistory.nothingStood: There was nothing to withdraw: no consent to this document was in force. The server answered with the state and not with an error.
consentHistory.atPostOnly: Withdrawn at the security post, in person.

setPassword.title: First sign-in: your own password
setPassword.lead: The one-time code from the letter is exchanged for a password only you know.
setPassword.codeNote: From the letter. It lasts an hour from the moment it was issued and works once.
setPassword.doneBody: The code is spent and every token this account already held is revoked. Sign in with the new password.
setPassword.mismatchBody: Type the same value into both fields.
setPassword.refusedBody: The server does not say which part failed: a one-time code is a secret, and answering “is there such an address” would be a hint. There are four causes:
setPassword.refusedCause1: no such address in the system;
setPassword.refusedCause3: the code has already been spent;
setPassword.refusedCause4: an hour has passed and the code expired.
setPassword.refusedWayOut: Ask the warden of your building for a new code.
setPassword.validationTitle: The form is filled in incorrectly
setPassword.throttledBody: Too many attempts have come from this address in a row and the server stopped taking them. You can try again in {{remaining}}.
setPassword.throttledBodySoon: Too many attempts have come from this address in a row and the server stopped taking them. Try again shortly.
setPassword.note: The number of attempts is limited here exactly as it is at sign-in: guessing at a one-time code is guessing.

guest.heading: Guests
guest.lead: The resident files the request, the duty officer of the building approves it, the security post records the entry and the exit.
guest.noResidency: A guest is invited by somebody who lives here. The register holds no place for you at the moment — speak to the warden.
guest.windowNote: The interval has to fall inside the visiting hours of this dormitory: {{from}} to {{to}}. The hours come from the building row rather than from the source — change the regime of the building and this form changes with it.
guest.windowBreached: The time given falls outside the visiting hours, {{from}} to {{to}}. The server will refuse the request.

fields.guestNameNote: As written in the document the guest will present at the post.
fields.docNumberNote: Stored encrypted and never returned. Screens show the last four characters.
fields.purposeNote: Optional. A stated purpose makes the decision easier.

guest.foreignBody: The request will be flagged and the warning about the university's procedure attached. A visit running past midnight is not approved without the mark of the officer responsible for migration registration.
guest.foreignNotSubmitted: The system submits no arrival notification of its own.
guest.filedBody: The duty officer of the building decides. The access code appears here once the request is approved: before the decision there is none.
guest.codeNote: Give it to the guest. At the post it is typed into the terminal.

guestQueue.heading: Guest requests
guestQueue.leadDuty: The duty officer of this dormitory decides. A refusal without a reason is impossible: the reason is stored and reaches the resident.
guestQueue.leadReadOnly: The queue of this dormitory, read only. The duty officer approves and refuses.
guestQueue.reasonRequired: The reason is required. The resident sees it in full.
guestQueue.reasonNote: A reason from the directory can be edited. Three characters at least.

reasons.quotaSpent: The number of guests approved for that date is already at the ceiling.
reasons.outsideWindow: The hours asked for fall outside the visiting window of the dormitory.
reasons.documentUnclear: The document data are incomplete or disagree with the request.
reasons.residentAbsent: The inviting resident is away at that time.
reasons.quarantine: Guests are restricted for now by an order over this dormitory.

guestQueue.officerMarkLabel: Mark of the officer responsible for migration registration
guestQueue.officerMarkNote: The document is a foreign one and the interval runs past midnight. Without the mark the server refuses.
guestQueue.officerMarkTitle: The responsible officer's mark is needed
guestQueue.officerMarkBody: A foreign document, and an interval running past midnight. Fill in the mark and approve again.
guestQueue.officerMarkGround: The arrival notification is the receiving party's duty (art. 20 part 2 of Federal Law No. 109-FZ). The system does not submit it.

quotaBody.resident: This resident already has {{limit}} approved for {{date}} — the ceiling for a day.
quotaBody.building: The dormitory already has {{limit}} approved for {{date}} — the ceiling for a day.

guestQueue.transitionTitle: The request has already been decided
guestQueue.transitionBody: It now stands as «{{status}}». Refresh the list.

guestDocument.warning: The document number in full is given on a request of its own. Every such reading is written to the audit log with your name on it.
guestDocument.recorded: The reading is in the audit log.

checkpoint.heading: Security post
checkpoint.lead: Find the guest, compare the card with the document, record the entry. What is recorded here is what the visitor register holds.
checkpoint.doctrine: The system restricts nobody's movement; it records what happened. Whether a person is admitted is decided by the security service under the university's local act. All the program refuses is to assert that an entry was within the rules when it was not.
checkpoint.noPost: No dormitory's security post is attached to your account.

search.heading: Step 1. Find the guest
search.codeNote: The code from an approved request. A scanner types it and presses Enter, which makes this one action.
search.surnameNote: A surname search covers today and no other day.
search.readOnly: The search changes nothing. A record appears only once the entry is marked.
search.noCodeTitle: No such code in this dormitory
search.noCodeBody: Check the code character by character. The request may be for another building, or may not be approved yet: before the decision there is no code.
search.noNameTitle: Nobody of that surname is expected today
search.noNameBody: A surname search covers today and no other day. Ask the guest for the code.

card.heading: Step 2. Compare with the document
card.maskedNote: The last four characters are shown: enough to compare against the document in hand. The number in full is not shown at the post.
card.consentPending: The guest's consent is not on record. It is taken here, before the entry: pressing «Record the entry» puts the text on the screen.
card.noEntryNote: To turn somebody away, simply do not record an entry. Verification and the record are separate steps exactly so that a refusal leaves no trace of an entry that never happened.

verdict.refused: The entry may not be recorded

reason.outside_permitted_interval: The time now falls outside the permitted interval.
reason.guest_already_inside: An entry on this request is already recorded.
reason.wrong_visit_date: The request is for another day.

refusal.title: No entry was recorded
refusal.overridable: The responsible officer's decision may admit the guest. The reason goes onto the visit and into the audit log.
refusal.final: This refusal is not one a decision sets aside.

override.heading: Admitted on the responsible officer's decision
override.body: The entry is recorded with a mark that it was made against the rule. The mark goes both onto the visit and into the audit log, so «show me every entry admitted against the interval» is one query.
override.reasonNote: Who allowed it and on what ground. Three characters at least.
override.action: Record the entry on the decision

entry.deadlineFrozen: The departure deadline is frozen on the visit: the earlier of the end of the interval and the dormitory's control time. Editing the building row no longer moves it.

exit.writtenOnce: The time of the exit is the server's and is written once. A mistake is put right by a correcting entry in the visitor register, never by rewriting the row.
exit.alreadyBody: The exit on this visit was recorded {{time}}.

consent.heading: The guest's consent
consent.separate: A step of its own and not a tick on the entry: art. 9 part 1 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ has consent executed separately from other documents.
consent.requiredTitle: Without consent no entry is recorded
consent.requiredBody: The server refused: the guest's consent is not on record. Show the text of revision {{revision}} and take the consent.

text.title: Consent to the processing of personal data — guest
text.draft: A placeholder text. It states what the system does with the data, but the operator's responsible officer has not approved it: before the system carries real data it is replaced under a new revision identifier.
text.purpose: I consent to the processing by the dormitory of my personal data, for the purpose of admitting me as a guest and of keeping the visitor register that clause 2.1.2 of the rules of internal order requires.
text.processed: Surname, name and patronymic; the type and number of the identity document presented at the security post; the room I am visiting and the resident who invited me; the time I entered and the time I left.
text.notProcessed: No copy, scan or photograph of the document is taken. The number is stored and shown masked.
text.ground: I am not a party to the accommodation contract, so this consent is the sole ground on which my data may be processed (art. 6 part 1 cl. 1 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ). Without it the dormitory cannot record my entry.
text.withdrawal: I may withdraw this consent at the security post at any time. Withdrawal ends the visit and stops further processing; the record that the consent was given, and the entries already made in the register, are kept for the period the local act sets.

consent.whatIsStored: The record holds the fact, the date and the revision of the text. A guest has no account, so the record names the request instead.
consent.refuseNote: If the guest does not agree, no entry is recorded and no trace of one is left.
consent.mismatchTitle: The text on the screen is a different revision
consent.mismatchBody: The server asks for revision {{server}}; the screen carries {{screen}}. Take the consent from the approved text kept at the post: a record naming a wording the guest never read proves nothing.

board.heading: Recorded at this terminal
board.scope: The list is built from what this terminal itself recorded during this shift and lives in the browser tab. The full record is the dormitory's visitor register, which the warden and the administrator keep.
board.empty: Nothing recorded at this terminal during this shift.

visitRegister.heading: Visitor register
visitRegister.lead: Guest, document, whom they are visiting, premises, entry, exit, and whoever recorded it. The six columns of clause 2.1.2 of the rules of internal order, plus the operator.
visitRegister.noClaim: The export is a presentation of the data. It carries no claim to satisfy any particular reporting obligation, and it stands in for the access-control integration this iteration does not build.
visitRegister.periodNote: The period is taken against the entry: a guest admitted at 23:50 on the 30th and recorded leaving at 00:20 belongs to the 30th, the day an officer would have written them down on.
visitRegister.exportNote: The document number is exported masked. The export itself is written to the audit log.
visitRegister.admittedOnDecision: Admitted on the responsible officer's decision: {{note}}
visitRegister.correctNote: The row does not change. The correction sits beside it and travels with it into the export.

announcements.heading: Announcements
announcements.lead: Notices addressed to your dormitory and to every dormitory. The feed shows what is in force; an announcement leaves it on its own the moment its validity runs out.
announcements.mandatoryNote: You are asked to confirm you have read this notice. The confirmation records who read it and when.
announcements.archiveNote: The archive is the other side of the same comparison: notices whose validity has run out. Nothing moves them there.
announcements.outstanding_one: {{count, number}} notice on this page is waiting for your acknowledgement.
announcements.outstanding_other: {{count, number}} notices on this page are waiting for your acknowledgement.
announcements.publishLead: The notice goes out at once and reaches the dormitory named. There is no publication date to set: a back-dated notice would prove nothing about the day the resident was told.
announcements.readersLead: The acknowledged share and the residents who have not read.
announcements.scopeBuildings: The figures cover: {{buildings}}. Residents of other dormitories are not shown, whatever the notice was addressed to.
announcements.readersAudited: Reading this list is itself recorded in the audit log: it is personal data assembled for a purpose.
announcements.notReadNote: The residents of the dormitories named above, less those the register says have moved out.

fields.audienceNoteAdmin: «Every dormitory» is the administrator's address and nobody else's.
fields.title: Title
fields.bodyNote: Line breaks are kept as they are typed.
fields.categoryNote: What the notice is about. Separate from whether it has to be acknowledged.
fields.mandatory: Ask residents to acknowledge this notice
fields.mandatoryNote: A notice marked this way is also delivered as a message the resident cannot switch off, and the acknowledged share becomes readable.
fields.expiresNote: Leave empty for a notice that does not expire. A moment already past is refused.

announcements.publishesNowhere: No dormitory is named in your appointment, so there is nowhere for this account to publish. The feed is still yours to read.

maintenance.heading: Repairs
maintenance.lead: Report a defect in your room or in a common area, and follow what happens to it. The request is closed by you and not by whoever did the work.
maintenance.noResidency: The register holds no active residency for this account, so there is no dormitory to report a defect in.
maintenance.filedBody: Bound to: {{place}}. The staff of the dormitory have been notified.
maintenance.ageNote_one: {{count, number}} day since it was filed.
maintenance.ageNote_other: {{count, number}} days since it was filed.
maintenance.noTargetYet: No date has been promised yet.
maintenance.reopenNote: The planned date stays as it was and is now visibly missed.
maintenance.autoClosedNote: Closed by the clock: the confirmation window of {{count, number}} days ran out with no answer. That is not the same as evidence the defect was fixed.
maintenance.confirmedNote: Closed on the word of the person who reported it.
maintenance.overdueThreshold_one: Counted late after {{count, number}} day, or past the planned date.
maintenance.overdueThreshold_other: Counted late after {{count, number}} days, or past the planned date.
maintenance.reporterLead: The work has been reported done. The request closes when you confirm it — or goes back into work if it is not fixed.
maintenance.windowOpen_one: You have {{count, number}} day to answer. After that the request closes by itself, marked as closed without an answer.
maintenance.windowOpen_other: You have {{count, number}} days to answer. After that the request closes by itself, marked as closed without an answer.
maintenance.triageLead: Take the request into work with a planned date, or refuse it with a reason. Neither is possible without its field.
maintenance.reasonRequired: A refusal without a reason is impossible: the resident reads this sentence.
maintenance.startLead: The request has been accepted. Report the beginning of the work; there is no way to report it complete without this step.
maintenance.completeLead: Report the work done. This does not close the request: it goes to the person who reported it for confirmation.
maintenance.nothingToDo: The request is {{status}}. There is nothing on it for the staff to do.
maintenance.windowClosedTitle: The window for answering has closed
maintenance.windowClosedBody_one: The confirmation window is {{count, number}} day, and it has run out. The request closes without an answer.
maintenance.windowClosedBody_other: The confirmation window is {{count, number}} days, and it has run out. The request closes without an answer.

fields.categoryNote: Pick «something else» rather than the nearest wrong one.
fields.locationNoteOwn: The room is taken from the housing register and is not asked for here.
fields.locationNoteCommon: A common area has no row in the register, so name it in words.
fields.locationNameNote: For example: the kitchen on the fourth floor, the shower room in block B.
fields.title: Short title
fields.titleNote: Optional. The category is used when it is empty.
fields.descriptionNote: At least ten characters. Say what happens and when it started.
fields.urgencyNote: Water on the floor now, or a wobbly chair whenever. The staff may change it on triage.
fields.urgencyTriageNote: The queue is ordered by this. Change it only if the resident's own choice is wrong.
fields.photosNote: Up to three. A photograph settles most arguments about what «broken» means.
fields.targetDateNote: Mandatory, and not in the past: the resident is told this date the moment the request is accepted.
fields.assigneeNote: Optional. A dormitory whose warden does the work himself has nobody else to name.
fields.reporterCommentNote: Optional. Goes into the history either way.
fields.reasonNote: At least three characters. The resident reads it.

photos.storedNote: The request carries paths into the file store rather than links. This build has no route that turns one into a picture, so the photographs are counted and not shown.

log.heading: History of the work
log.appendOnly: Entries are added and never edited
log.scheduler: By the clock, with nobody deciding

maintenance.rejectedNote: Refused before it entered work. The reason is in the history below.

maintenanceQueue.heading: Maintenance queue
maintenanceQueue.leadTriage: The requests of this dormitory, most pressing first and oldest first inside one urgency. Accept with a date, refuse with a reason, or report the work.
maintenanceQueue.leadReadOnly: The requests of this dormitory, most pressing first and oldest first inside one urgency. Taking a request into work promises a date, and that promise is the warden's to make.
maintenanceQueue.filterAge: At least this old, in days
maintenanceQueue.filterAgeNote: Counted from the day the request was filed, never from the day it was accepted.
maintenanceQueue.filterPeriodNote: Measured on the day of filing. Leave both empty for the whole queue.
maintenanceQueue.exportNote: The file carries the same rows and the same filters as the screen. The download is recorded in the audit log: an export discloses who reported what and when.
